title: Cylinder
spec: Start by creating a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero degrees for all axes and a translation vector also set to zero. Next, draw a two-dimensional sketch on the first face. In the first loop, draw a circle centered at coordinates (0.028, 0.028) with a radius of 0.028. In the second loop, draw another circle with the same center but a smaller radius of 0.025. After completing the sketch, apply a scale factor of 0.0559 to the entire sketch to adjust its size. Transform the scaled sketch into a three-dimensional object by rotating it using the same Euler angles and translating it using the same translation vector. Finally, extrude the sketch 0.75 units along the normal direction to create a solid cylindrical body. The final dimensions of the cylinder will be a length and width of 0.05590551181102362 units and a height of 0.75 units.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Define the initial coordinate system
workplane = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create the sketch for the base of the cylinder
sketch = (
    workplane
    .center(0.028, 0.028)  # Move to the center of the circle
    .circle(0.028)         # Draw the outer circle
    .circle(0.025)         # Draw the inner circle
)

# Extrude the sketch to create the cylinder
cylinder = sketch.extrude(0.75)

# Assign the final model to 'r'
r = cylinder

height = 0.7500

    .circle(inner_diameter / 2.0)
